record.question: Which among the following city in India has the highest availability of 4G according to a survey by 'Open Signal'?
record.explanation: Answer C: Dhanbad. The OpenSignal survey named Dhanbad as the Indian city with the highest 4G availability among these choices; this is time- and methodology-specific. Reference: https://www.opensignal.com/reports/2019/02/india/mobile-network-experience. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
